facts.fact: The Bank of Namibia issued Directive PSDIR-10 under section 44 of the Payment System Management Act, 2023 (Act No. 14 of 2023), effective on signature on 31 March 2025, with contravention an offence.
Directive PSDIR-10 sets the regulator's deadline of 1 April 2027 for payment service providers to execute low-value cross-border Common Monetary Area transfers through the TCIB scheme.
